judgeAgent.description: The criteria judge's harness and model; a dataset.json may give its own.

store.description: Where runs of cases are kept, in place of ~/.awf/lab/{project}-{first commit}; never inside the repository.

records.description: A folder inside evals/ the run, trial and score records are also written to, to be committed, so a fresh clone sees them.

hide.description: Paths in the code folder, relative to it, the lab's box hides as it hides keys: tracked files that hold or quote a key, such as an older lab's fixtures.
